sites.note: confidence=medium. DataOne owns and develops the site and Nebius is the tenant serving a Microsoft contract. MATERIAL CAVEAT: the source says about 85 percent of the 350 MW is self-generated from pipeline gas and only about 15 percent comes from Vineland Municipal Utilities and Atlantic City Electric, so most of this load will not appear in PJM demand. The PJM/AE zone is inferred from Vineland's position inside the Atlantic City Electric zone.

confidence=high. Nebius' own page states 800 MW from municipal utility Independence Power and Light (first power H2 2026) plus 400 MW of future on-site generation on a 400-acre campus sized to 1.2 GW, and explicitly cites "IPL participation in the Southwest Power Pool (SPP)" - so the SPP balancing-authority attribution is stated, not inferred. No SPP sub-zone established.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
notes: Grid-only. Excludes power purchase agreements and renewable energy certificates.
Unweighted across sites; we do not know each site's load.
